summary: Iteration 23 - All features verified. AI Assistant feedback merged into chat bubble (FAB button removed), Performance Hub Cascade View with 5 RAG signals and triple targets, Category Segmentation editor with validation working correctly. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All critical features verified via Playwright.
seed_data_creation: Test segments created during testing for plan validation
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 23 features verified. Key confirmations: 1) AI Assistant FAB at bottom-left with data-testid='ai-assistant-fab', 2) Welcome message mentions feedback option, 3) 'Give Feedback or Report an Issue' quick action button exists, 4) Separate FeedbackButton FAB removed from App.js, 5) POST /api/ai-assistant/chat with mode='feedback' submits feedback (returns feedback_submitted=true), 6) POST /api/ai-assistant/chat with mode='auto' detects feedback keywords (bug, issue, report, etc), 7) Performance Hub Cascade View is default tab for admin users, 8) CEO Executive Summary shows 5 RAG signals (Revenue vs Plan, Activity Coverage, Collections Health, Pipeline Coverage, Team Execution), 9) CascadePlanCard shows triple targets with progress bars, 10) Segment button on unsegmented cards opens editor dialog, 11) Segment Editor validates category totals match plan targets (within 1 OMR tolerance), 12) GET segments returns actuals and pipeline data per category.
